source.title: Edit and preview documents directly in Gemini

slides.heading: Gemini can edit files in chat
slides.body: Google announced new ways to create, preview and edit files directly in the Gemini app.

slides.heading: What can you do?
slides.body: Open a file in chat, make edits, highlight text to ask questions, or ask Gemini to refine it.

slides.heading: Web or mobile?
slides.body: Google says PDF preview and editing work on web and mobile. The other listed formats are web-only.

slides.heading: Try it with a sample
slides.body: Open Gemini and try a non-sensitive document. Check the resulting edits and any important details yourself.

caption: Google announced new file editing and preview features in the Gemini app on October 29, 2026. PDF preview and editing are available on web and mobile; Google says the other listed formats are web-only. Check your account for access and verify AI-made changes. This is a summary of Google's announcement, not a hands-on test.
